{"body":"
### Changed
- **pi-action fits the images of every tool to the model** (#93, changed in #94). pi-action now uses one image processor for each run, also without `extensions`. `read` resizes and converts the images it returns to the limits of the model, and pi-durable's `fit-images` extension does the same for the results of all other tools, such as MCP tools, before the thread stores them. Extensions can no longer use the name `fit-images`. See [Images](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.5/docs/extensions.md#images).
- **Updated pi to 1.6.0** (#93, changed in #94). pi-action uses pi-durable, pi-ai, and chord 1.6.0. The system prompt is the same as in pi 1.5.2. The examples in the docs now use pit v0.39.2. See [The system prompt](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.5/docs/prompts.md#the-system-prompt).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.5.4...v2.5.5

{"body":"
### Changed
- **pi-action fits the images of every tool to the model** (#93, changed in #94). pi-action now uses one image processor for each run, also without `extensions`. `read` resizes and converts the images it returns to the limits of the model, and pi-durable's `fit-images` extension does the same for the results of all other tools, such as MCP tools, before the thread stores them. Extensions can no longer use the name `fit-images`. See [Images](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.5/docs/extensions.md#images).
- **Updated pi to 1.6.0** (#93, changed in #94). pi-action uses pi-durable, pi-ai, and chord 1.6.0. The system prompt is the same as in pi 1.5.2. The examples in the docs now use pit v0.39.2. See [The system prompt](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.5/docs/prompts.md#the-system-prompt).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.5.4...v2.5.5
